patterns.migration_pattern: Django migrations use Migration class with operations list. Use AddIndex with models.Index() for adding database indexes.
patterns.composite_index: For frequently combined filters, use composite indexes like models.Index(fields=['is_active', 'status'])

existing_implementations.description: Found extensive filtering on status, movement_type, is_active, and created_at fields across multiple models in inventory, purchasing, and production apps. Views frequently filter by status (e.g., DRAFT, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED) and is_active=True.
relevant_files: apps/purchasing/models.py - PurchaseRequest, PurchaseOrder, Receiving (all have status fields)
apps/production/models.py - ProductionOrder, Bin, Batch (all have status fields)
apps/core/models.py - BaseModel with is_active field inherited by most models
apps/materials/models.py - Material, Supplier, MaterialCategory (inherit is_active from BaseModel)
filter_patterns_observed: Date range filters on created_at for reporting

composite_indexes_needed.rationale: Views often filter by multiple fields together (e.g., is_active=True AND status='IN_PROGRESS')

indexes.reason: List views filter by warehouse and movement_type, ordered by date
